create.name: Brian Thomas Swimme
create.bio:
Brian Thomas Swimme is a mathematical cosmologist who has spent his career telling the scientific story of the universe as a story that matters for how people live. He earned a PhD in mathematics from Oregon in 1978 for research on gravitational dynamics, and later taught for many years at the California Institute of Integral Studies (CIIS), based in San Francisco. A long friendship with the cultural historian Thomas Berry shaped his work, and together they wrote The Universe Story. With Bruce Bochte he founded a centre devoted to the universe story, and he now also leads work on the noosphere at the Human Energy project.

His central theme is that each person is part of a fourteen-billion-year process of emergence, and that seeing ourselves this way can change how we treat one another and the Earth. He explores this in books such as The Hidden Heart of the Cosmos, The Universe Is a Green Dragon and, more recently, Cosmogenesis, where he places his own life inside the cosmic narrative. He co-wrote and presented the Emmy-winning film Journey of the Universe with Mary Evelyn Tucker, and his long-form lecture series, including The Powers of the Universe and Canticle to the Cosmos, can be watched free on his centre's website.

books.title: Cosmogenesis: An Unveiling of the Expanding Universe
books.author: Brian Thomas Swimme
books.description: Swimme retells the major events of cosmic history, from the early universe to human awareness, while weaving in episodes from his own life as a scientist. He argues that a cosmologist cannot stand outside the universe he describes, and invites readers to see themselves as part of the story.

free_resources.title: The Powers of the Universe
free_resources.description: An eleven-part lecture series, around nine hours in all, in which Swimme looks at forces such as allurement, emergence and synergy at work both in the cosmos and in human life. All episodes play free on his centre's site.

free_resources.title: Canticle to the Cosmos
free_resources.description: His classic twelve-episode lecture course tracing the story of the cosmos, the Earth, life and humankind, told with a sense of the sacred. Free to watch online.

free_resources.title: The Earth's Imagination
free_resources.description: Eight video talks placing the human psyche within cosmic and planetary evolution and asking where human consciousness may be heading. Free on his centre's site.

free_resources.title: The Hidden Heart of the Cosmos
free_resources.description: A three-part video programme linked to his book of the same name, looking at the generosity of the sun, where the universe began and the nourishing emptiness beneath all things. Free to watch.
